text:
SOURCE-ASSISTED READING (stams-2026-10-30b), made with the Bamberg breviary of 1575 (pp. 745-750) and Analecta Hymnica 26 no. 77 at hand. Reread on the native images by a research reader: canvas 0, left leaf (pencil 107-2r) lines 1-21, right leaf (107-1r) lines 1-9 and 18-28; canvas 1, left leaf (107-2v) lines 1-10 and 22-29, right leaf (107-1v) lines 8-29. Canvas 1 left lines 11-21 and right lines 1-8 were read by a second research reader before opening a source. All other lines rest on the image-only first reading and are not given here. Expansions in ( ); [ ] lost, damaged or supplied; ? uncertain; | line break not marked.

Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-1vn7/Stams_STA_Frg_107_01r02r.jpg (canvas 0) and https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-1vn7/Stams_STA_Frg_107_01v02v.jpg (canvas 1), each 7360 x 4912. Regions x,y,width,height in native pixels. Text order: canvas 1 left, canvas 0 left, canvas 1 right, canvas 0 right.

Canvas 1, left leaf (107-2v), region 2250,1350,1300,650 (Kunigunde, Matins nocturn III):
[Reginae torum immaculatum auctor diabolus] inquinatu(m)? maculare cogita(vit). Qua(m) deus munda(m) [comprobavit]. V. Hec e(st) regina ethyopie q(ue) ve(n)it audire verba sap(ienti)e. Qua(m) deus. R. [In] casta xp(istu)s v(ir)gi(n)e sibi desponsata serva(vit) sine crimine federa firmata du(m) p(er) igne(m) transijt exp(er)s lesio(nis). Inde v(ir)t(us) prodijt divine iussio(nis). V. Ignis ea(m) no(n) tetigit nec quicq(uam) contristauit neq(ue) malu(m) intulit q(ua)m fides roborauit. Ind(e) v. R. [T]hesauru(m) in agro hec v(ir)go i(n)ve(nit) du(m) deu(m) p(at)re(m) in carne filij reperit que(m) inventu(m) in cord(e)

Canvas 1, left leaf, region 2200,1980,1360,640 (second research reader; Lauds):
suo abscondit. Et cunctis facultatibus p(re)tulit. V. O(mn)ia sua vendens agru(m) emit q(uia) xp(istu)m p(re) o(mn)ib(us) dilexit. Et cuncti(s). Ad laudes an. [V]inculu(m) caste dilect(ion)is d(omi)n(u)s s(er)va(vi)t du(m) kunegundis v(ir)g(in)is innocencia(m) (com)probat. an. Integritatis ei(us) testimoniu(m) p(er)hibuit et humilitatis custodia(m) s(em)p(er) adhibuit. an. Itaq(ue) gl(ori)a ei(us) mag(is) ac mag(is) proficiebat quia deum toto me(n)tis affectu diligebat. an. [T]ande(m) rex sub vite fine vocatis amicis regine ha(n)c p(er) manu(m) (com)mendat illis talib(us) verbis memoria dignis. an.

Canvas 1, left leaf, region 2250,2650,1300,500 (Benedictus antiphon, Second Vespers):
[...] (con)signata(m) ipsi xpo (et) vob(is) resigno v(ir)gine(m) imma-culata(m). Sup(er) b(e)n(edictus) a(n). [I]n sanctitate et iusticia contemnentes mu(n)di vicia seruiam(us) tibi d(omi)ne cu(m) b(ea)ta kunegunde v(ir)gine. In s(ecun)dis v(esperis) R. [D]eus p(ate)r mi(sericordi)e fons totius? gr(ati)e p(er) merita kunegundis v(ir)ginis. Nos solue nexu crim(in)is. V. Ut ab eternis ignib(us) libere(mur) (et) d(e)mo(n)ib(us). Nos
(lower third of the page blank)

Canvas 0, left leaf (107-2r), region 2350,1400,1150,650 (Henry, First Vespers):
¶ Canonisac[io]nis? s(an)c(t)i heinrici Imp(er)atoris. Ad v(esperas) sup(er) ps(almos) Omnia laudate. An. [F]esta pii ymperatoris heinrici t(ota) devoc(i)o(n)e venerem(ur) ut apud d(omi)n(u)m q(ui) sum(m)e pi(us) [est] meritis (et) p(re)cib(us) eius adiuvari mereamur. Cap. I[ustus] cor suum. R. [C]onu(er)so ad summu(m) studio p(ro)pagande religionis xp(ist)iane deo devot(us) p(ri)nceps eccl(es)ie babergensis sede(m) fundat. Qua(m) p(re)dijs ministerialib(us) ornamentis exaltat. V. Cursu tande(m) co(n)su(m)ato felici sp(iritu)s celu(m) i(n)g(re)dit(ur)?

Canvas 0, left leaf, region 2350,2000,1150,650:
corp(us) in fundata sede colloca(tur). Qua(m). ymnus Voce n(un)c. V. Gl(ori)a (et) honore. Sup(er) Mag(nifica)t [C]horus nove ih(e)r(usa)l(e)m in laud(e) regis su(m)mi (con)gratulat(ur) nove proli catholice m(at)ris b(ea)to heinrico dig(n)o (con)fessori quo p(ro) nob(is) in cel(is) exorante rex (et) pastor i(n) teris xpe nos miseros respice. Oratio Deus qui b(ea)tu(m) heinricu(m) p(er) terreni imperii insignitu(m) ethereis sedib(us) collocasti tribue q(uesumu)s ut q(ui) eius? signis miraculo(rum) clare cer(n)im(us) eunde(m) in te[r]cessor(em)? in angustijs? sentiam(us) p(ro)p(itium)? | ¶ Ad Mat(utinum) Invit(atorium) [V]enite iubilem(us)

Canvas 1, right leaf (107-1v), lines 1-8, region 3900,1300,1250,600 (second research reader; Matins nocturn I):
q(ue) caput ei(us) gr(ati)a v(ir)tutu(m) exaltat et profectu(m) cu(m) p(o)p(u)lo suo b(e)n(e)dixit. Ps. D(omi)ne q(ui)d. V. Gl(ori)a et ho(nore). R. Illustre(m) vir(um) germine nobilitatis xp(ist)i co(n)fessor(em) laude p(er)sonem(us). Floruit enim ta(m) xp(ist)iana religio(n)e qua(m) generosa seculi dignitate. V. P(re)vect(us) s(piritu)s s(an)c(t)i rore fructu(m) dedit ex fidei germine. Floruit. R. [C]ultor xp(ist)i no(n) fict(us) dux bauarie heinric(us) ad titulu(m) s(an)c(t)i emerammi

Canvas 1, right leaf, region 3900,1850,1300,650:
dux bauarie heinric(us) ad titulu(m) s(an)c(t)i emerammi mirifico divinit(us) p(re)sagio p(er)docet(ur). Quo ad fructu(m) iusti(cie) arti(us) excitat(ur). V. Vidit e(n)i(m) con(tra) se p(ost) sex p(re)notatu(m) sed q(uo)d p(re)tenderet nu(n)c ignotu(m). Quo ad fructu(m). R. [E]xaratos sed sig(na)tos apices co(n)iecturis dux ve(n)tilat. Qui suspect(us) huc p(er) nu(meru)m d(e) obitu dies menses annos sex in virtutu(m) fructu(m) accumulat. V. Sexto anno p(re)sagiu(m) resolvit(ur) dux regno p(re)ficit(ur). Qui susp(ectus). In 2o noct(urno) an. [V]ite celestis amator(em) s(an)c(tu)m suu(m) d(omi)n(u)s mirificauit unde sacrificiu(m) iusti(cie) sacrificauit

Canvas 1, right leaf, region 3900,2450,1300,700:
ps Cu(m) i(n)uocare(m). an. Letet(ur) i(n) te rex iusticie qui sperat i(n) te letabit(ur) s(an)c(tu)s tecu(m) quia p(er) te inhabitabit(ur) in eternu(m). ps Verba mea. an. [?]usti? (con)fessor(em) b(ea)tu(m) laudem(us) gl(ori)a (et) honore coronatu(m) q(ui) sub falsa corona vera q(ue)siuit p(re)mia. ps D(omi)ne d(omi)n(u)s n(oste)r. R. [T]rabeatus in vestitura rex nobil(is) vigilante corde linea(m) advertit condicio(nis). Et licet o(mn)i regno spectabilis spe ta(men) futuris exercet(ur) in p(re)mijs. V. Attendit rede(m)ptor(em) suu(m) infra o(mn)es humilitate sup(er) o(mn)es maiestate. Et li(cet). R. [C]u(m) adysset ca(usa) religionis

Canvas 0, right leaf (107-1r), region 4250,1420,1200,630 (Matins nocturn II):
[rex beatus?] i(n) mo(n)te cas[sinum] expe(r)t(us) visio(n)e corpus s(an)c(t)i b(e)n(e)dicti no(n) translatu(m). Cui(us) s(an)c(t)itatis testimonio s[olu]it(ur) quo laborab(at) calculo. V. Exc(i)t(us)? rex manu calculos tenuit donarijs mu(l)tis rec[ompen]sa(vit) donu(m) q(uo)d accepit. Cui(us). R. [I]am [sacri] principis fama p(ro)pagat(ur) hostes fidei iugo xpi p(er) eu(m) subdu(n)t(ur) regno rebelles edoma(n)t(ur) fundant(ur) eccl(es)ie. Et marsipol(is) in sui restauracio(n)e gloriat(ur). V. Ubi et ca[licis ablutio]

Canvas 0, right leaf, region 4250,2550,1200,700 (Matins nocturn III):
[vestigia imi]tat(us) humilitat(is) ih(es)u xpi merito e(n)im exaltabi(tur) qui p(ro) xpo humiliat(ur). ps D(omi)ni e(st) terra. V. Mag(na) e(st) g(loria). R. [C]rescente sub p(re)sta(n)ti principe regni victoria (et) gloria s(er)uo? xpi barbaries cessit ongaria q(ue) soror(em) suam stephano regi copulat. Et gente(m) conv(er)sam p(er) fidem (et) baptismu(m) eccl(es)ie (con)signat. V. Salvat(ur) v(ir) infidel(is) p(er) muliere(m) fidele(m). Et ge(ntem). R. [Æ]terna tactu(s) (et) tractu(s) sapiencia rex b(ea)t(u)s castitatis emul(us) matrimoniale ius despexit sed (con)sorte(m) thala(m)i adult(er)ij suspicio
